read_only_reviews.scope: Read-only minimal Qwen retained-budget integration review; no product edit/build/model/native/GPU run
read_only_reviews.status: frozen recommendation for root implementation; no runtime acceptance claim

necessary_changes.change: Use storage_lease(cache_budget) for each accepted history/recurrent output (36 per member) and selected carry_hidden; accepted-two also budget prior_hidden. Apply this uniformly to caller and generated outputs: same-scope original pool admission is idempotent. Keep ID/logits/trace/probe temporary result exports unbudgeted by cache_budget.

Finish all retained-output budget admission for ALL members before the first take_append. Keep original export -> all 12 target + 2 draft takes -> ready/reframe -> unbind -> nonthrowing complete-head swap. Native quota failure must never first publish a subset of heads or consume some bank publications before the budget check.

Keep cache::plan geometry/N/R/physical inventory, but do not use its CUDA caller-output backing_bytes as native auto byte limit or as a native N-fitting estimator. For native auto retain an explicit auto/unbounded admission mode; for native explicit finite cache bytes keep requested N/R and enforce actual known pool + real output-retention reservations. If a cold known pool or completed-result admission does not fit, fail honestly through the existing transaction. CUDA preallocated-pool binary selection can stay in its existing actual caller-pool path.

known_cache_backing_bytes remains fixed actual arena/initial-state/actual caller-output pool backing, not a snapshot of dynamic usage. prepare_state_storage cold equality can remain valid before any result exists. The restore/adoption-time usage == known check must allow dynamic retained-output charges (at least usage >= fixed known base); do not mutate the known base to make equality appear true.

Report budget mode/explicit limit, fixed known base, actual cache budget live/peak requested bytes, and unknown native execution-private backing separately at all CLI output surfaces, including single-MTP print_mtp_request (currently receives no Model). Neither live nor peak retention accounting is a measured Metal/process peak. Do not keep describing all generated retained backing as unknown after successfully accounting it, or change the unknown-private execution fact to false.

existing_failure_path.fact: After original actual retirement, try_abort recovers every bound append, destroys the failed original Invocation, rolls back pending append reservations/discards failed writers, drops all next/base episode pins, and releases admission. finish catch invokes the same abort. Budget export failure before first take therefore fits this path without a second executor or extra recovery protocol.
existing_failure_path.constraint: Old heads stay installed until all fallible work is complete. Admission must include overlap of old live heads and new candidates; do not credit a future old-head release early. A finite quota may reject a transaction whose eventual final footprint would fit, because atomic publication requires both versions temporarily.

paths_easy_to_miss.fact: carry is required for all MTP roles, including teacher-forced single/prefill/catchup; prior is newly exported when verify accepts two. Both need retention admission before any take. Draft key/value are already the independently charged 2 arena backings, not another generated state pool.

Twelve/fourteen shared arenas and actual state/hidden initial/caller pools are already globally charged. Initial zero carry/state and output aliases of these pools must preserve same-scope charge, not be added as per-head logical bytes.

Directory/Hit/Session hold the same complete SnapshotRef. Exported leases already carry the scope; lookup/adopt/fullhit0Graph need no new native allocation or logical-size charge. A prefix checkpoint can retain an old backing after its source advances, so directory eviction is not proof bytes are gone when another Session/slot/native use still owns it.

paths_easy_to_miss.path: strict restore and normal committed-token rebuild
paths_easy_to_miss.fact: Both rebuild through normal prepare/submit/finish; central finish retention covers new states/carry. Quota failure keeps temporary session cleanup and caller ledger facts; do not inject old GPU state or suppress admission to make restore fit. Every intermediate replay boundary can remain charged if an original slot/input/export retains it.

These exports exist to read actual completed output and diagnostics. They should not turn every native output into cache retention. If such an alias shares an already-budgeted domain it can conservatively extend that domain charge, which is expected, not a second logical payload charge.

export_port caches the original ReadLease by port. bind/submit and the existing qualified binding-release path clear projections, but not every idle Phase/slot is necessarily immediately reused/destroyed. A charge attached to that same domain may outlive the last Snapshot; usage must remain authoritative and no fixed-base equality may claim that it was released.

report_semantics.known_cache_backing_bytes: Actual one-time arena/initial/caller-pool backing reserved by this Model. It is a base, not all retained state after native execution.
report_semantics.cache_live_requested_bytes: Current actual ResourceBudget usage for the nominated device, including fixed base plus deduplicated retained generated backings. It includes legitimate lingering domain/slot/real-use owners.
report_semantics.cache_peak_requested_bytes: Peak of that managed retention admission scope. Not native physical allocator peak, RSS, total unified memory, or transient execution allocation.
report_semantics.auto: No numeric native closed-form backing estimate is substituted for the requested auto policy. Explicit flag/null limit can accompany actual ResourceBudget SIZE_MAX internal limit.
report_semantics.finite_limit: Completed-result retention and known-pool quota. Native operations can have allocated opaque/transient backing before retention admission, so this is not a before-allocation device-memory safety cap.
report_semantics.unknown: execution_budget.unattributed_usage/selected native private storage remains an explicitly separate unknown bound. The new cache accounting does not cover native intermediates, compiled artifacts, allocator cache, drivers, or weights.

verification_suggestions_not_run: Finite cap just below one required new backing: failure occurs at storage_lease before first take; all 14 transactions abort and old head/state/pending facts remain authoritative.
Same prefix head adopted twice has one shared native backing charge; original slot or real native use may delay its eventual release.
Single-MTP, multi-MTP and ordinary scheduled/restore reports distinguish actual dynamic live/peak retention from the fixed shared inventory and auto/explicit mode.

read_only_reviews.status: final narrow source review; no blocking finding; no new compile/native/GPU execution

confirmed.fact: cache_usage distinguishes fixed known pool inventory from native dynamic retained outputs; cache_report labels managed retention scope/live/peak and unknown native execution-private storage, emits null for SIZE_MAX limit, and denies a physical VRAM cap. retain_state_storage preserves original failure propagation.

All participants history/recurrent and selected carry/prior use the retained cache budget before the first target/draft take. Original failure catch/abort and nonthrowing complete-head publication ordering remain intact.

Native auto uses an unbounded retained-admission scope rather than the CUDA caller-output formula. Explicit native bytes do not derive a smaller N using that formula. CUDA exact preallocated-pool selection remains unchanged.
Ordinary restore/adoption now calls the compatible cache_usage check rather than requiring native dynamic usage equal the fixed shared inventory.

Single MTP, multi-MTP aggregate and subresults, ordinary scheduled aggregate/subresults and ordinary legacy output all include the same Model cache_report. No unbudgeted persistent state/carry export remains in the reviewed finish diff.

important_boundaries: Every cache_report describes one whole Model budget snapshot. Multi-session subresults repeat this global scope; their live/peak values must not be added as if per-session allocations.

Native original slot.exported/projected arrays, trace aliases, existing input bindings and actual native uses can legitimately retain a budgeted LeaseDomain after its Snapshot is evicted. The new fields reflect that lifetime, not directory size.

A finite limit bounds known pools and completed-result retention. The operation may have already allocated native transient output/intermediate storage; this is not a pre-allocation Metal/process peak cap.
Explicit quota failure is an honest transaction failure after original abort. This implementation intentionally does not add an LRU retry or early-release old heads inside finish.
The review binds the current source/diff only. Root-provided CUDA/Apple finite runs are not independently rerun or extended here.
